RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel at a public broadcaster is a potential concern, as many public institutions have explicit gender-balance rules for hiring panels. While this composition does not prove conscious discrimination—the decision may genuinely reflect an emphasis on digital media strategy over seniority—it increases the risk of unconscious affinity bias. 

Do not level accusations immediately. Instead, first follow up with HR on your written feedback. Once received, assess whether the criteria and scoring were objective and consistent with the job description. If the feedback is evasive or reveals breaches of the broadcaster’s internal diversity guidelines, you have solid grounds to raise the panel's composition through HR or your union.
